中文功能定位: 独立诊断或修复已有 Modelica 物理模型的具体故障；只诊断不修改，物理修改和交付按需引用主规则。
英文功能定位: Independently diagnose or repair failures in existing Sysplorer Modelica physical models, including checks, translation, generated-solvers, initialization, state selection, index reduction, nonlinear systems, events, runtime numerics, and external C functions. Use when a concrete failure or abnormal result exists; do not use for ordinary model construction, domain design, or API lookup.
